title: Acceptance probability under tester conversion
statement: For every natural number $n$, every $n$-variable E3-Lin sign tester $T$, and every function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with values in $[-1,1]$, the acceptance probability of the converted E3-Sat tester is $\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{4}$ times the acceptance probability of the converted sign tester.
hypotheses_covered: An E3-Lin sign tester T on n-dimensional cube inputs
A function f on the n-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in [-1,1]
